tweets.author: thebitcoinact.xyz
tweets.text:
Regulators are creating a proper retail pathway only because Bitcoin already has the liquidity and track record others lack.
The product sits under full fund rules rather than lighter product rules.
That is further recognition of Bitcoin’s established market position.

tweets.author: thebitcoinact.xyz
tweets.text:
Switzerland has listed Bitcoin products on the SIX Swiss Exchange for years.
Those are debt securities.
This new vehicle is an investment fund, so custody, operational risk and disclosure rules under fund law apply.

tweets.author: thebitcoinact.xyz
tweets.text:
The exception exists because Bitcoin has a longer trading history and much higher trading volumes than most other cryptocurrencies.
Those market facts let the regulator treat Bitcoin differently from the rest of the sector.
No other asset received the same carve-out.

tweets.author: thebitcoinact.xyz
tweets.text:
This is not another exchange-traded product.
It sits in the category of other funds for alternative investments with a specific risk.
FINMA granted an exception to its normal diversification rules so the fund can hold Bitcoin alone.

tweets.author: thebitcoinact.xyz
tweets.text:
Switzerland’s FINMA has approved the country’s first spot Bitcoin ETF for retail investors.
The fund invests directly in Bitcoin under actual Swiss fund rules.
Other providers are already seeking the same approval.
